neighbours.label: the holder of a statement or attitude: ' by' naming who recommended or announced something, ' of' after hope, ' even' after surprised; ' by' and ' of' of place or size stay quiet
fire: This hotel was suggested to us by a friendly neighbor.
Details will be announced next week by the city council.
It is the hope of the committee that this will succeed.
The decision surprised even the mayor.
The film was recommended to me by my sister.
Further news will be released later by the club.
It is the wish of the family that no flowers be sent.
Her victory shocked even her own coach.
quiet: This hotel was built close to a friendly village.
Details are on the wall next to the city hall.
It is the color of the sky that makes this look nice.
The decision came after the storm.
The film was shot in Spain with my sister.
Further south you will find the club.
It is the height of the fence that keeps the deer out.
Her horse trotted past her own house.

short: ' by' / ' of' naming who says or hopes
